findings.limitations: Single smoke-test execution under fixed-pv-pq-single-slack/1 with fixed case118, flat initialization and recorded environment; no replication, comparison of iteration budgets, minimal-budget estimate, or actual iteration count inferred. Independent validation reports operational_status=violated with six reactive-generation limit violations and 186 thermal limits unassessed. Equation validity does not establish operational feasibility. No generalization, feasibility or novel-method discovery is claimed. Broader sampler/solver research was not executed and is unsupported by this bounded execution profile.
findings.statement: My hypothesis was that a maximum iteration budget of 20 for the fixed case118 flat-start Newton reference would yield final maximum mismatch below 1e-6 pu. Trial trial_f8100ecdb54f490fa1450757b1946c52 completed successfully with iterations=20. Separate independent validation observations report max_mismatch_pu=3.935784299266862e-13, equation_valid=true and input_preserved=true, supporting the hypothesis for this single bounded calibration execution. This is my evidence-linked candidate author claim, not an independent validation endorsement of the finding.
